camel_example: aliyun r-kvstore DescribeSlowLogRecords --region cn-hangzhou --OrderBy execution_time --OrderType ASC --EndTime '2019-03-10T15:00Z' --PageSize 30 --InstanceId 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000' --PageNumber 1 --SlowLogRecordType proxy --NodeId 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000-db-0' --StartTime '2019-03-10T14:00Z' --DBName 0 --QueryKeyword keyword1
description_en: Queries the slow query logs of a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance that are generated within a specified period of time
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例在指定时间内产生的慢日志
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore describe-slow-log-records --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --node-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000-db-0 --start-time 2019-03-10T14:00Z --end-time 2019-03-10T15:00Z --db-name 0 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --slow-log-record-type proxy --query-keyword keyword1 --order-type ASC --order-by execution_time --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSlowLogRecords

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the node in the instance. You can set this parameter to query the slow query logs of a specified node.

This parameter is available only for read/write splitting and cluster instances
parameters.help_zh:
实例中的节点ID。传入本参数可查询指定节点的慢日志信息。
当实例的架构为读写分离或集群架构时，本参数才可用
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. The time range cannot exceed one day. We recommend that you specify 1 hour. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间，且起止时间的范围不能超过1天（推荐范围为1小时），格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 30, 50, and 100. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页可展示的最大记录数，取值：30、50、100，默认值为30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The type of the slow logs. Default value: db. Valid values:

proxy: slow logs of proxy nodes
db: slow logs of data nodes
parameters.help_zh:
慢日志类型，取值：
proxy：代理节点中的慢日志。
db：默认值，数据节点中的慢日志
parameters.name: slow_log_record_type

parameters.help_en: The keyword based on which slow logs are queried. You can set this parameter to a value of the string type
parameters.help_zh: 可设置一个字符串类型的值，使用该值作为关键词对返回结果进行搜索
parameters.name: query_keyword

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order of the results to return. Default value: DESC. Valid values:

ASC: ascending order
DESC: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果的排序方式，取值：
ASC：升序。
DESC：默认值，降序
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en:
The dimension by which to sort the results. Default value: execution_time. Valid values:

execution_time: sorts the results by query start time.
latency: sorts the results by query latency
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果的排序依据，取值：
execution_time：默认值，按照请求的执行开始时间排序。
latency：按照请求的执行耗时排序
parameters.name: order_by

Engine.description_en: The database engine that the instance runs

LogRecords.description_zh: 由慢日志信息组成的集合

DataBaseName.description_en: The database name. This parameter serves the same purpose as the DBName parameter. We recommend that you use the DBName parameter
DataBaseName.description_zh: 数据库名称，与DBName作用一致，推荐使用DBName参数

ElapsedTime.description_en: The amount of time consumed to execute the slow query statement. Unit: microseconds

ExecuteTime.description_en: The start time when the slow query statement was executed. The time is displayed in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format

IPAddress.description_en: The IP address of the client

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of log entries returned on the current page

PageSize.description_en: The maximum number of log entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 每页显示的日志数上限

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the query

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of returned log entries
